## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first (per AGENTS.md). Dispositions:
- **DF-S1.25-2 (F)** — names this ticket: "Stage 2 closes the
  resume-checkpoint hole: checkpoints become persistent (offload/blob),
  the resume path restores the driver from the last persisted
  checkpoint." `KernelSink::checkpoint` now persists to the blob pool;
  `open_resume` rehydrates the driver. Verify for real → DONE/PARTIAL.
- **DF-S1.25-3 (F)** — "durable content-addressed artifact store":
  the sealed definition bytes are now deposited into the blob pool at
  open (`harness_def_ref` is a content address), so `get_artifact`
  survives a service restart → DONE if the restart test lands.
- **DF-S1.5-1 (F)** — Stage-2 ledger ops surface: S2.3 lands the
  suspend/resume/wakeup portions; `fork`/`navigate`/`redact`/`gc`/
  rewind remain S2.9+'s → stays OPEN (partial discharge noted).
- **DF-S1.20-1 / DF-S1.20-2 (F)** — Stage-2 control machinery (suspend/
  wakeup/restart surfaces): S2.3 lands the ledger-level ops; the
  driver-level rerun-with-updated-context and §05g `defer` arm stay
  S2.6/S2.12's → stays OPEN unless evidence says otherwise.
- All other OPEN rows inspected — owned by later tickets. (No
  `DF-S1.16-1` row exists; the `preserve_until` sizing leg named in the
  plan landed as `PRESERVE_UNTIL_TTL_MS` + the AC-14 bound test.)

## Requirements

The ticket stamps **R-2.2.3**, **R-2.2.3⁰ᵇ**, **R-2.2.2¹** and gates on
**AC-R-2.2.3-{5,6,7,8,9,11,14} + AC-R-2.2.4-{1,3,9,12} +
removability(0…3)** (deterministic) + the universal phase-gate AC.

| id | deliverable |
|---|---|
| scoped leases (C1) | `LeaseScope ∈ {writer, effect(id), resource(key), environment(handle), wakeup(sub,key)}` — `acquire/renew/release/takeover` over `lifecycle.lease.{acquired,renewed,released,fenced}` with `scope`; generation-fenced to the writer generation; `WouldBlock`/`Fenced` |
| liveness shortening | `probe_holder(lease)` — same-host dead (pid gone or `start_id` mismatch) ⇒ takeover before `expires_at`; off-host ⇒ wait for expiry (AC-5) |
| `suspend` (C1) | `suspend(run, lease, reasons[], subscription_ids[], release_lease = true)` → `lifecycle.run.suspended`; `OpenCommittedEffects` when any effect is `prepared`/`deferred`/`committed`; suspended runs exempt from liveness-based takeover; KP-10 (crash between `suspended` and `released`) completes on next restore |
| wakeups (C1) | `WakeupSubscription`, `WakeupPolicy` (OQ-316 ratified: `follow_up` only), `subscribe`/`occurred`/`fire`/`skipped`/`cancelled`/`due(now)`; kernel-internal triggers `timer`, `permission_decided`, `child_terminal`, `effect_terminal`, `retry_due`; occurred durable before fired; at-most-once claim lease per `(subscription, occurrence)`; `skipped{duplicate_occurrence|already_claimed|expired|subscription_cancelled|run_finished}` audited; KP-11 restart-safe |
| delivery discipline | `drain_wakeups`/`deliver_wakeup` — `follow_up` deliveries held while an effect is `committed` (W-3; AC-8), delivered at the next decision point |
| `compensate_run` (C1) | audited best-effort saga — `compensable` effects observed `applied`, reverse commit order, compensators as effects with `compensates` in causes; idempotent mid-saga crash resume; failure ⇒ `abandoned` + `lifecycle.escalation.raised` (R-2.2.2¹, AC-R-2.2.2-4/B2-04) |
| `verify_environment` (C0·S2) | verdict-returning resume-time verification: `attached | reattachable | lost{cause ∈ {helper_gone, image_missing, workspace_missing, lease_expired, containment_changed}}`; `action.environment.verified` row per handle in the checkpoint view |
| detached reconciliation (C0·S2) | `reconcile_detached` — `list_detached` over `committed` effects' `detached_effect_ids[]`; each child → `observed`/`unknown`/`terminated` written by the resuming writer; `preserve_until` ttl ≥ writer_ttl + recovery_grace; past-ttl ⇒ `terminated` (AC-14) |
| `verify_resume` integration (C0·S2) | `open_session{resume}` applies `verify_resume(persisted, current)` when a re-presented definition is supplied: add-only ⇒ `lifecycle.definition.changed{diff_ref}` + continue; otherwise `DefinitionChanged` (AC-11) |
| HLC (C0·S2) | continuation/child runs stamp `hlc` on every event; seeded causally above the source head (ADR-0131 §5) |
| `restore` integration | `open_session{resume}` IS `store.restore` (spec §5a.3): takeover + recovery table + exactly one `lifecycle.run.resumed{from_seq, lease, recovery_decision, holder, cause}`; driver rehydrated from the persisted `control.decision.checkpoint_ref` (closes DF-S1.25-2) |
| `HealingPolicy` (C1) | `{on_lost ∈ {fail, ask, reprovision, snapshot_restore_then_reprovision}, max_heals, reattach_window_ms, heal_no}`; `heal` → `healed{new_handle, restored ∈ {full, snapshot{ref}, none}, lost_items_ref} | refused{reason} | ask{permission_id}`; reprovision = a ledgered Π-authorized effect; `heal_no > max_heals` ⇒ `MaxHealsExceeded` ⇒ `stop{infrastructure_failure{environment_lost}}`; `lost_items_ref` observation at `authority = environment`; `suspended` meters don't accrue (AC-9) |
| `coherent_fork_points` (C0·S2; AC-R-2.2.4-1) | pure projection: seq coherent iff every model_call/effect scope opened ≤ it is closed ≤ it (effects terminal/deferred/detached); agrees with brute-force evaluation; `ForkPointNotCoherent{open_scopes[]}` |
| source immutability (AC-R-2.2.4-3) | the S2.3 half: property — new ops (suspend/resume/wakeup/compensate) never rewrite a source prefix; head-hash-at-seq stable + `verify` green |
| snapshot semantics (AC-R-2.2.4-9) | `fs_tree` `snapshot_ref ≡ snapshot_id` = the content address (tree rule) — unchanged workspace ⇒ same address; `uncaptured[] ⊇ {network_connections, wall_clock, entropy}`; GC'd-restore ⇒ `SnapshotMissing` with the still-verifiable hash; two `derive(ForkSnapshot)` ⇒ distinct handle identity material |
| `SpeculationPolicy` floor (AC-R-2.2.4-12) | HarnessRule-class record `{allow_classes, require_compensator, max_concurrent_branches, budget_fraction, coverage_required, defer_irreversible = true}`; a layer/`authority_cap`/diff widening past the parent (`defer_irreversible = false`, `allow_classes` ⊋) ⇒ refused — wired into `materialise_overrides` and exposed for S2.9's `fork` |
| removability | `tier-c1` feature on hh-ledger/hh-env gating the C1 surface (`suspend`, wakeups, scoped leases, `compensate_run`, `HealingPolicy` healing) — absent ⇒ typed `UnsupportedTier{tier: c1}` refusals; `scripts/check-removability.sh` extended |

## Acceptance criteria

| AC | plan |
|---|---|
| AC-5 liveness shortening | hh-ledger tests: dead same-host holder ⇒ takeover before expiry; alive same-host ⇒ `WouldBlock`; fabricated `start_id` mismatch ⇒ refused until expiry; off-host spelling ⇒ refused until expiry |
| AC-6 suspension invariant | suspend under prepared/deferred/committed ⇒ `OpenCommittedEffects`; suspended+restored run emits no `prepared`/`committed`/`observed` for intended-only effects; takeover of a suspended run's live lease via probe ⇒ refused (exempt) |
| AC-7 wakeup idempotence | 3 deliveries of one occurrence ⇒ 1 `fired` + 2 `skipped`; simulated KP-11 (occurred, drop store, reopen, deliver) ⇒ still exactly one `fired`; occurrence for finished run ⇒ `skipped{run_finished}`; timer scheduled before crash fires after restart |
| AC-8 decision-point delivery | `fire` while an effect is `committed` ⇒ `fired{deliver_after}` recorded, `drain` withholds until the terminal lands; driver-level test: `Cue.woken` reaches the decide input only after `EffectsSettled` |
| AC-9 env verify + heal | `local_host` workspace deleted ⇒ `verify_environment = lost{workspace_missing}`; `reprovision` policy ⇒ ledgered effect + `healed{restored: snapshot{ref} | none, lost_items_ref}`; `lost_items_ref` observation at `authority = environment`; `ask` ⇒ pending permission + `ask{permission_id}`; `heal_no > max_heals` ⇒ `MaxHealsExceeded`; suspended meters don't accrue |
| AC-11 resume verification | re-presented sealed doc with an added tool ⇒ `lifecycle.definition.changed` + resume proceeds; removed tool that was delivered ⇒ `DefinitionChanged` refusal |
| AC-14 detached reconciliation | `DetachedSource` seam: preserved child ⇒ reconciled `observed`/`unknown` written by resuming writer; past-`preserve_until` ⇒ `terminated`; `hh-helper` live test asserts `preserve_until ≥ writer_ttl + grace` on the wire (S2.1 `resume_helper` thread) |
| AC-R-2.2.4-1 | `coherent_fork_points` agrees with brute force over constructed ledgers; `check_fork_point` returns `ForkPointNotCoherent{open_scopes}`; the `fork`-call half is S2.9's (shared AC) |
| AC-R-2.2.4-3 | property: suspend/wakeup/compensate/resume leave every source prefix byte-identical; `verify` green after each op |
| AC-R-2.2.4-9 | unchanged-workspace `fs_tree` snapshots share `snapshot_ref`; `uncaptured` superset asserted; deleted-blob restore ⇒ `SnapshotMissing{tree_address}`; two `derive(ForkSnapshot)` ⇒ distinct handles/roots |
| AC-R-2.2.4-12 | override layer setting `speculation_policy.defer_irreversible = false` ⇒ refused pre-ledger; `allow_classes` widening ⇒ refused; narrowing admitted |
| removability(0…3) | check-removability green incl. `cargo test -p hh-ledger --no-default-features` / `-p hh-env` refusal legs |
| universal | workspace green; tests fail-if-removed; ids stamped; DEFERRALS rows; ADR-0265; BUILD_INDEX + LEDGER |

## Plan

1. `hh-ledger`: `hlc.rs` (HLC seed/stamp on lineage runs), `leases.rs`
   (scoped leases + probe), `suspend.rs`, `wakeup.rs`, `saga.rs`,
   `branch.rs` (coherent_fork_points), classes/errors/manifest additive
   members, `restore` enrichment (`recovery_decision`, `cause`, KP-10
   suspended-lease completion).
2. `hh-env`: `recovery.rs` — `verify_environment` verdict op,
   `reconcile_detached` (helper `DetachedSource` seam), `heal` under
   `HealingPolicy` + `lost_items_ref`; snapshot identity
   (`fs_tree` `snapshot_ref = tree_address`, `uncaptured`,
   `SnapshotMissing`); `preserve_until` sized off `lease_ttl`.
3. `hh-hir::speculation` — `SpeculationPolicy` + `check_floor`;
   hh-embed override gate wiring.
4. `hh-embed`: `open_resume` → `store.restore` + driver rehydrate from
   `checkpoint_ref` blob + per-handle `verify_environment` +
   `verify_resume` when `resume.definition` is supplied; sealed-def
   bytes into the blob pool at open (DF-S1.25-3 half).
5. Tests per matrix; ADR-0265; DEFERRALS; verification; build memory.

### Progress

- `hh-ledger` (all `tier-c1`-gated, `default = ["tier-c1"]`):
  - `hlc.rs` — `H<physical-hex>.<logical-hex>.<node>`; stamped only on
    lineage-bearing runs (`continued_from`/`forked_from`/`parent_run_id`),
    seeded causally above the anchor's own `hlc`; plain runs carry none.
  - `leases.rs` — `LeaseScope::{Effect,Resource,Environment,Wakeup}` +
    writer; `probe_holder` three-valued (`host=…;pid=…;start=…` claim);
    suspended runs exempt from shortening.
  - `suspend.rs` — `suspend(run, lease, reasons, subscription_ids,
    resume_policy, release_lease)`; `OpenCommittedEffects` on any
    prepared/deferred/committed effect; KP-10 completed on restore.
  - `wakeup.rs` — `WakeupSubscription`/`WakeupPolicy`/`Occurrence`;
    the kernel-internal five (`timer`, `permission_decided`,
    `child_terminal`, `effect_terminal`, `retry_due`); `subscribe`/
    `occurred`/`fire`/`skipped`/`cancelled`/`due`/`deliver_wakeup`/
    `wakeup_drain`; W-1 claim idempotence, W-3 `deliver_after`
    withholding; Stage-4 triggers refuse typed.
  - `saga.rs` — `compensate_run`: applied compensable effects in
    reverse commit order; compensators are real effects with
    `compensates` in causes; mid-saga crash resume idempotent;
    failure ⇒ `abandoned` + `lifecycle.escalation.raised`.
  - `recovery.rs`/`store.rs` — `restore` enriches: recovery-decision
    payload + `cause`, retry-timer re-derivation, suspended-lease
    completion, pending-permission surfacing, idempotent second
    restore; `branch.rs` — `check_fork_point`/`coherent_fork_points`/
    `nearest_coherent_seq` + `ForkPointNotCoherent{open_scopes}`.
  - `effect.rs` — the phase fold (intended→…→terminal); retryability =
    risk-class-gated; `observed{terminated:true}` unconditionally
    terminal (ADR-0265 D3).
- `hh-env`: `recovery.rs` — `verify_environment_verdict` (attached/
  reattachable/lost{cause}), `reconcile_detached` (preserved child ⇒
  `observed`; past `preserve_until` ⇒ `terminated` written by the
  resuming writer), `HealingPolicy` + `heal_with_policy`
  (reprovision-as-ledgered-effect, `healed{restored, lost_items_ref}`,
  `ask`/`fail` postures, ledger-counted `max_heals`), snapshot identity
  + restore + `SnapshotMissing`; `PRESERVE_UNTIL_TTL_MS`/
  `DEDUP_WINDOW_MS` named constants.
- `hh-hir`: `speculation.rs` — `SpeculationPolicy` (`defer_irreversible`
  hard floor; `allow_classes`/bounds narrow-only; conditioned rules
  need debt records) + `check_override`.
- `hh-embed`: `open_session{resume}` IS `store.restore` — takeover
  (in-process `CarriedRuntime` carry) or durable resume
  (`persist_leaf` writes `leaf.checkpoint`+`leaf.arm` atomically at
  every drive boundary; restart path rehydrates `Driver::resume`,
  restores pending asks/active turn from the durable prefix, re-verifies
  every env handle, stamps `lifecycle.session.attached{restore_cause}`);
  `verify_resume` on a re-presented definition (`Compatible` ⇒
  `lifecycle.definition.changed`; `Incompatible` ⇒ `DefinitionChanged`,
  zero mutation); sealed-definition bytes persisted to
  `artifacts/<version_id>` → blob pool (DF-S1.25-3); `drive()` drains
  durable wakeups into `Cue.woken` (D4); `gate_speculation_floor` at
  override evaluation (D6); `OpenSpec::Resume.definition` added to the

- `hh-helper`: `preserve_until`/`dedup_window` honest `unsupported`

### Self-review

- Read the diff top to bottom. The checkpoint is a view artifact —
  `leaf.checkpoint` bytes restore leaf *state* under the committed
  prefix's authority; nothing treats it as a second store.
- The `terminated` foreclosure (D3) is deliberately narrow: only the
  `terminated` member on `observed` — written solely by
  `reconcile_detached` — bypasses retryability; ordinary
  `observed{not_applied}` still stays open for probe-gated retry.
- The woken dedup set is intentionally in-memory (D4): persisting it
  would make a fired-never-delivered occurrence *lost* across a crash —
  the opposite of AC-7.
- `deliver_wakeup`/`wakeup_drain` run inside `drive` *before* the sink
  borrow — a borrow-split decision, not a semantic one; the rows mint
  durable-first as usual.
- New C1 ops all route through `Store::tier_c1`/`UnsupportedTier` or
  `EnvError::Unsupported{heal}` — grep-verified, removability-tested.
